_comment: GH#92 D3: the room ledger -- its OWN conversation surface so no existing hub's cursor/option pins move (three canonicals broke when the tiers rode erin_errand; lyonette_tip is pinned too). Lyonette keeps the register; tier-1 gates on resolved_wrong_order (HER arc) so the early-game inn stays purchase-free.

hub.speaker: Lyonette
hub.text: The room register. Lyonette's hand, every line ruled straight: names, nights, and three columns of prices. One entry has been scraped clean and rewritten.

text_variants._comment: #350: FIRST rung on purpose -- later-match-wins, so a tiered player still reads their tier line below.
text_variants.text: Your name has a line of its own in the register now, with the first room past the stairhead written beside it.
The register has your name against the draughty single now, in Lyonette's ruled hand. Paid, and the column beside it says so.
Your line in the register has been rewritten one column over, neater than it needed to be. Lyonette moved you up herself.
The register lists your room at the top of the page now, underlined once, the line ruled against a straightedge. The three entries beneath it start lower down the page to make room.

options._comment: #350 THE LEASE, and THE PRICE: 20 lives in this option's text, requires.gold and effects.gold, nowhere else. Sanctioned {gold, accomplishment} compound -- the accomplishment leg HIDES the row until the player has been upstairs, the gold leg greys it visible after. hide_when is meant to be PERMANENT. Authored FIRST, and hidden at near_room_upgrade (no visited_own_room), which is what keeps room_upgrade_loop's and dialogue_numkey_loop's visible-index pins intact.
options.text: Put my name against the first room past the stairhead. (20 gold)

options._comment: Tier chain: each requires the previous, hides once owned. Persistent +1 max HP each via _room_tier_bonus (wi_game.gd).
options.text: Have the draughty single properly aired and banked. (25 gold)
Pay for the good mattress and the window that shuts. (60 gold)
Best bedding in the inn, under your own window. Whatever it costs. (120 gold)

lease_done.speaker: Lyonette
lease_done.text: Lyonette rules the line before she writes in it. "Paid. First door past the stairhead. The key is yours, the room is yours, and the noise out of the common room is unfortunately also yours."

tier_thanks.speaker: Lyonette
tier_thanks.text: Lyonette enters it without looking up, and the line comes out straight. "Paid in full. I'll have it aired and the fire banked by tonight — you'll sleep better than you have been."

text_variants.text: Lyonette enters it without looking up, and the line comes out straight. "Paid in full. Aired and swept. The draught is stopped — you'll get up with more in you than you have been."

Lyonette blots the line and looks up for once. "The good mattress and a window that actually shuts. I checked the latch myself this morning." She writes the new price small, to fit the column she had already ruled for it.
Lyonette underlines it. "Best bedding in the house, and I will know if you don't use it. The goose down came up from Celum by wagon, and the price of it still makes me angry. Use it."
